message.description: The message that records what landed: a subject line, a blank line, then a body saying what changed and why. No trailers. Where your step stages a merge, the run commits it with this message once its check passes; where it lands another way, this is the message you made the landing with, repeated here for the record. Empty when you sign off blocked: a done sign-off with an empty message has the run take back a merge it would have committed.
